structure.unit: Volunteer Firefighters' and Rescue Squad Workers' Service Award Fund

law.catch_line: Administrative fee for rejoining the Fund
law.text: Any individual who had been a member of the Fund and who applies to rejoin the Fund shall not be entitled to membership until he has paid an administrative fee of twenty-five dollars. The Board shall elect to waive the twenty-five dollar fee for members reinstated pursuant to subsection B in § 51.1-1209.
